blockers.detail: agents/src/trader/ does not exist in this repository. Only agents/src/firefly/ is present. The trader CLI (cli.py, orchestrator.py, tools/yfinance_client.py) has not been implemented yet.

Yahoo Finance HTTPS access is blocked by the outbound proxy: CONNECT tunnel returns 403 for fc.yahoo.com and all finance.yahoo.com endpoints. All 15 tickers in the watchlist returned zero data. One retry attempted — same result.

fallback: TRADER_OFFLINE=1 (no LLM scan possible without trader pipeline; no price data possible without network access to Yahoo Finance)
notes: First run — no prior daily-trader synthesis pages exist to backtest against. FOM formula documented in wiki/synthesis/daily-trader-2026-10-11.md for use once the pipeline and network access are available.
